tasks.title: One heading parser, one canonical brief heading set
tasks.objective: Add parse_sections to factory_lib.py and put docs/product/BRIEF.md, harness/nestjs-react/BRIEF_TEMPLATE.md and harness/nestjs-react/conventions/plans.md on the same heading set, adding Target Outcome.
acceptance_criteria: parse_sections(text) returns a mapping of '## ' heading to its body text, with the body stripped, and lives in factory/scripts/factory_lib.py.
A heading present with only whitespace beneath it maps to an empty string; emptiness is never decided by a length or word-count threshold.

BRIEF_TEMPLATE.md and conventions/plans.md use Summary, Users, Target Outcome, Key Flows, Domain Concepts, Constraints, Out of Scope — the live brief's set plus Target Outcome, with What/Who/Flows/Out of Scope (v1) gone.
docs/product/BRIEF.md carries ## Target Outcome and no existing heading in it is renamed.
The existing suite still passes: forge.py init scaffolds a brief that record_signoff.py accepts.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "parse_sections or scaffold or init"
tasks.reviewer_focus: That parse_sections has exactly one home and that the template and the live brief cannot drift apart without a test failing.

tasks.title: Sign-off refuses an incomplete brief
tasks.objective: Extend record_signoff.workflow_input_problems so a brief missing a required heading, or carrying one with an empty body, refuses sign-off and names the heading.
acceptance_criteria: record_signoff.py refuses when docs/product/BRIEF.md is absent, missing a required heading, or has a required heading whose body is empty.
The refusal names every offending heading, not just the first.
The brief problems join the existing problem list, so specs, roadmap and brief are reported in one refusal rather than through separate paths.
A complete brief still signs off, and the whole existing suite still passes.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "signoff or brief"
tasks.reviewer_focus: That the check reuses parse_sections rather than re-parsing, and that emptiness means no non-whitespace content.

tasks.title: Spec confirm refuses an incomplete spec
tasks.objective: Require an H1 title plus Why, Behaviour and Acceptance criteria at forge spec confirm, before the grill check, while leaving spec save free-form.
acceptance_criteria: forge spec confirm refuses a spec missing an H1 title, ## Why, ## Behaviour or ## Acceptance criteria, and names what is missing.
The heading check runs before require_grill, so an incomplete spec is refused without needing a grill first.
forge spec save still accepts an incomplete draft.
A heading present with an empty body is refused on the same terms as an absent one.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "spec"
tasks.reviewer_focus: That the casing matches the specs already on disk and that draft capture is genuinely unaffected.

tasks.title: Doctor reports capture gaps without blocking
tasks.objective: Report a brief or spec that predates this contract through forge doctor as advisory checks, so older projects are visible without being refused.
acceptance_criteria: forge doctor reports a brief missing required headings and names them.
forge doctor reports each confirmed spec missing a required heading.
Both checks are non-required, so a project captured before this contract is reported and never blocked.
Neither check emits a line when there is nothing to report.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "doctor"
tasks.reviewer_focus: That the checks are advisory and that a legacy fixture is reported rather than refused.
